definition: Track a submission through review and read health, topline, error-breakdown, and usage metrics for a published connector.
outcome: the developer can see where a submission stands in review and read the health, usage, and error metrics of their published server

records.outcome: the developer has seen where the submission stands in review and read the reviewer's feedback, with an email escalation path
steps: Read the submission's status and any reviewer feedback

evidence.quote: track your submission's status and read reviewer feedback in the [submissions dashboard](https://claude.ai/admin-settings/directory/submissions)

records.notes: Post-publication health and usage metrics are on the Managing your listing page, not here.
